steps.en: Scaffold an app from a template
Write the capability once, as an action
steps.zh: 把能力写一次，写成一个 action

steps.en: Mounts it on every surface: UI hooks, HTTP, MCP, A2A, CLI
steps.zh: 把它挂到所有出口：前端 hook、HTTP、MCP、A2A、CLI

steps.en: Call the same action from a React page
steps.zh: 在 React 页面里调同一个 action

steps.en: The agent reads the description + schema and calls it as a tool in chat
steps.zh: agent 读描述和 schema，在聊天里把它当工具调用

steps.en: Keeps agent work and UI state in one SQL database
steps.zh: 把 agent 的操作和界面状态存进同一个 SQL 库

value.en: You write the capability once; the button, the chat agent and any MCP host all run the same code
value.zh: 能力只写一次；页面按钮、聊天里的 agent、外部 MCP 主机跑的都是同一份代码

sources: README.md Quick start (npx --yes @agent-native/core@latest create ...) and 'Example: a shared action' (defineAction, useActionQuery)
packages/core/docs/content/getting-started.mdx (create my-app --standalone --template chat; actions/hello.ts; useActionQuery from React)
packages/core/docs/content/actions-overview.mdx (auto-mounted at /_agent-native/actions/<name>; MCP/A2A/CLI surfaces call the same action)
packages/core/docs/content/agent-surfaces.mdx (dedicated agent loop for chat; shared SQL-backed app state)
packages/core/docs/content/mcp-protocol.mdx (every app auto-mounts /mcp for external MCP hosts)
